create_mvssynthwai_dataset: create an MVSSynthWAI dataset instance with a specific split, root directory, and resolution
run_mvssynth_dataloader: run the MVS Synth WAI dataloader to iterate over scenes and visualize views with rerun
load_data_mvssynth: load precomputed dataset metadata for a specific split from the MVS Synth scene list numpy file
get_views_from_scene: get sampled views from a scene including images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics
sample_specific_scene: sample a specific named scene from the MVS Synth dataset instead of all scenes in the split
